project.name: KNIRV_NETWORK
project.description: The public KNIRV network: KNIRVSERVER launcher and the services it runs (KNIRVGATEWAY, KNIRVCHAIN, KNIRVGRAPH, KNIRVORACLE, KNIRVHASHER, KNIRVAGENT, KNIRVULORA, KNIRVARENA), shared libraries (KNIRVINFERENCER, KNIRVBASE, KNIRVSDK), protobufs, P-language models, integration tests, and the knirv.com sites.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the root README.md and the KNIRVSERVER package README to understand the project's purpose: a Decentralized Trusted Execution Network (D-TEN) that turns AI failures into collective knowledge via sovereign blockchain layers. These docs lay out the component map, entry points, and the supervision/trust model that the rest of the tour expands on.

tour.title: KNIRVSERVER Launcher
tour.description: KNIRVSERVER is the network launcher and server binary that bootstraps and orchestrates the KNIRV services. main.go is the process entry point, and internal/launcher/launcher.go spins up the embedded backend_server plus each network service (authority, bao, models, oracle) as managed subprocesses.

tour.title: KNIRVCHAIN Blockchain Layer
tour.description: KNIRVCHAIN is the core blockchain that records AI knowledge as on-chain nodes and transactions. cmd/knirvchain/main.go is its binary entry point, while internal/blockchain/blockchain_server.go hosts the consensus, block, and transaction pool logic that underpins the entire network's trust layer.

tour.title: KNIRVGATEWAY Service
tour.description: KNIRVGATEWAY is the network gateway that routes external traffic into the services. Its entry point cmd/gateway/main.go boots the gateway server, providing the HTTP/RPC front door that other services and clients communicate through (note: the oracle is no longer managed here).

tour.title: KNIRVGRAPH Service
tour.description: KNIRVGRAPH provides the external graph database that stores the knowledge representation as a navigable graph. pkg/knirvgraph/manager.go manages the lifecycle of the embedded graph binary, exposing graph queries used by agents and the memory system.

tour.title: KNIRVORACLE Service
tour.description: KNIRVORACLE is the oracle that anchors network state and signs rollups, loaded only when an encrypted root key is present. pkg/knirvoracle/manager.go orchestrates the oracle lifecycle, failover, and replica status, routing privileged operations through the root node.

tour.title: KNIRVAGENT Service
tour.description: KNIRVAGENT runs the autonomous AI agents that operate across channels and tools. cmd/knirvagent/main.go is its entry point, and pkg/agent/loop.go implements the core agent reasoning loop that drives sessions, memory, and tool execution.

tour.title: KNIRVULORA Service
tour.description: KNIRVULORA manages fine-tuned LoRA adapters that specialize model behavior on the network. pkg/knirvulora/manager.go handles adapter registration and lifecycle, feeding the LoRA bundles referenced by the blockchain's skill registry.

tour.title: KNIRVARENA Service
tour.description: KNIRVARENA is the 3D real-time-strategy arena where agents are visualized and trained. pkg/knirvarena/manager.go runs the embedded arena runtime, connecting the competitive simulation layer to the broader network.

tour.title: Shared Lib: KNIRVINFERENCER
tour.description: KNIRVINFERENCER is a shared library of deep reasoning prompts that power the network's inference calls. Its README and go.mod define the prompt-engineering primitives reused across services for elite problem-solving and systems-architect thinking.

tour.title: Shared Lib: KNIRVBASE
tour.description: KNIRVBASE provides the foundational primitives (PQC tooling, node runtime, conformance utilities) shared across packages. Its README and TypeScript package describe the base layer that other services build cryptography and transport on top of.

tour.title: Shared Lib: KNIRVSDK
tour.description: KNIRVSDK is the client SDK that lets external applications and frontends talk to the network (actuarial, local core, crypto). Its README documents the npm package surface that the websites and dashboards consume.

tour.title: Contracts: Protobufs & P-Language Models
tour.description: The network's contracts live in two forms: protobuf schemas (e.g. cortex.proto) that define wire formats for inference and memory, and P-language models under modp/ that formally verify network invariants. KnirvNetwork.pproj and checkpoint_machine.p encode the Merkle checkpoint and governance state machines.

tour.title: Frontends & Websites
tour.description: Two frontends expose the network: the KNIRVSERVER React/Next.js dashboard (page.tsx) and the KNIRVARENA 3D game (App.tsx, ArenaClient.ts) networking client. The public websites under websites/KNIRV.NETWORK publish SDK and documentation, bridging users to the on-chain services.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Integration Tests
tour.description: The network is built, configured, and validated through Makefile targets, the server-api.yaml contract, and real-service integration tests. integration-tests/cmd/validate_network/main.go and validate_network_startup.go exercise the full multi-service stack end to end with no mocks.
